title: Origin story: Oshun
description: Oshun was the youngest orisha, goddess of the river that bears her name, whose sweetness and diplomacy accomplished what force could not. When the male orisha excluded her from their councils and their works failed, they learned that without Oshun nothing succeeds — she is the power that makes power work.

title: Power ranking: Oshun

title: Stamina feats: Oshun

title: Crossover notes: Oshun

title: Cultural impact: Oshun
